title: LEGO: Lido Ecosystem Grants Organization
description: LEGO funds individuals, projects and initiatives that benefit the Lido protocol and the broader blockchain space. Grants come in four sizes, from Sandgrain (up to $1,000, one member approves) to Mountain ($100,000 and up, DAO vote). You start by pitching the LEGO Council member for your area on Telegram.
reward: Sandgrain up to 1,000 USD; Pebble up to 10,000 USD; Boulder up to 100,000 USD; Mountain 100,000 USD and up
summary: $1,000 to $100,000+ by tier · no deadline stated
ideas: Developer tooling for stETH and wstETH integrations
Node operator or validator monitoring tooling
A DeFi integration that adds stETH utility

eligibility.note: work that benefits the Lido protocol or its ecosystem (stETH, node operation, governance, DeFi integrations)

setup: message the LEGO Council member for your area on Telegram
each_time: a short pitch: title, authors, purpose, summary, details
agree terms and deliverables with the LEGO member
rules: No application form or deadline is stated. Contact the LEGO person responsible for your area (or any LEGO person, who will forward you) on Telegram with a short pitch.
Sandgrain: nice-to-have contributions one person can evaluate, up to 1,000 USD, approved by 1 member.
Pebble: non-critical, small things that benefit Lido, up to 10,000 USD, approved by 2 members.
Boulder: big, important work done by experts and evaluated by core contributors, up to 100,000 USD, approved by a Council vote.
Mountain: critical improvements to Lido's growth, security or operations, 100,000 USD and up, approved by a DAO vote.
You agree terms, timelines and deliverables with the LEGO member; the proposal is then shared on research.lido.fi and with the LEGO committee for review.
On completion you present the work to the LEGO committee.

Council domains: general and tech; community, growth and education; governance and DeFi integrations; Ethereum liquid staking; node and validation tech; node operation, decentralization and future of staking.
